apps/web/components/features/admin/Creat.error: Upload failures are surfaced inside AvatarUploadable and the notifications toast (onError); the cell itself renders no error UI to show.

apps/web/components/features/admin/creat.offline: The content is a pure render of its props and makes no network request; the in-flight state is shown by the Loading story.

apps/web/components/features/admin/lists.permission-denied: Access is enforced by the admin route before this component mounts; it renders no denied state.

apps/web/components/features/admin/lists.offline: The page only reads a query; a failed request is the Error state, and the component has no separate offline UI.
apps/web/components/features/admin/lists.permission-denied: Access is enforced by the admin route before this component mounts; it renders no denied state.

apps/web/components/features/admin/outbo.offline: The rail renders props and makes no request; an action failure is the Error story.
apps/web/components/features/admin/outbo.permission-denied: It only presents existing evidence and never grants approval; access is enforced by the admin route.

apps/web/components/features/admin/outbo.offline: The panel renders the readiness prop and makes no request; a failed fetch is the isError state shown by ErrorLoadFailed.

apps/web/components/features/agent-room/.permission-denied: The roster is presentational over an already-projected agents array; it has no access check and renders no denied state.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.offline: The pill is presentational over props and makes no request; link verification failures are its error state.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.permission-denied: The component has no access check; callers decide whether to render it.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.long-content: The component renders only icons and fixed menu labels (Edit, Hide or Show, Delete); no caller text can overflow.
apps/web/components/features/dashboard/a.permission-denied: The component has no access check; callers decide whether to render it.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.offline: The card reads one query; a failed or offline request renders the same unavailable row shown by the Error story.

apps/web/components/features/dashboard/o.error: The list renders already-loaded member data; copy and QR failures surface only as toasts (tested), with no in-component error UI to show.
